name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Dark Annihilators
archetype: Special Fire/Psychic high-speed artillery, Dark/Ground immunity pivots, and physical Intimidate breakers.
gym_duel_rationale: Sabrina's high-speed Psychic arsenal demands total type immunity and unstoppable offensive pressure. Enter the arena with Houndoom/Dugtrio (Dark/Ground powerhouse whose Dark typing completely negates Sabrina's Psychic STAB while firing STAB Foul Play, Nasty Plot, and +1 Sucker Punch priority), Snorlax (540 BST sponge with 160 HP and 110 SpD ignoring Special attacks and crippling sweepers with Body Slam), Charizard/Alakazam (505 BST titan with 117 SpA and 113 Speed outspeeding Sabrina's roster to fire STAB Flamethrower and Psychic), and Gyarados/Primeape (Intimidate physical breaker carrying super-effective Crunch and STAB Waterfall).

roster.progression_notes: 505 BST special demon with 117 SpA and 113 Speed. Outspeeds Sabrina's entire roster. Sets up Calm Mind and shreds foes with STAB Flamethrower and STAB Psychic.
470 BST predator with 105 Speed. Complete immunity to Psychic moves. STAB Sucker Punch provides crucial priority against Gengar/Alakazam, while Foul Play punishes physical threats.
540 BST juggernaut with 160 HP and 110 SpD. Thick Fat neutralizes Ice and Fire attacks. Amnesia walls Sabrina's special barrage while Body Slam paralyses fast psychic sweepers.
510 BST physical powerhouse with 115 Attack. Intimidate softens physical hits, while super-effective Crunch tears through Sabrina's Psychic core.
485 BST pivot. Sleep Powder halts aggressive setup, and STAB Giga Drain dismantles Water-type fusions like Alakazam/Slowbro.
470 BST physical fortress with 95 Speed. Immune to Electric moves. Sets up Swords Dance and fires devastating STAB Earthquake.

flex_bench.progression_notes: 535 BST tank with 130 HP. Free gift from Silph Co. Water Absorb completely neutralizes water attacks.
455 BST kicking master with 120 Attack and 110 SpD. Reckless boosts High Jump Kick into a devastating single-target nuke.
